card.name: Ends of lactic acidosis and suicidality terms
card.fires_on: The ending of 'lactic acidosis' (the 'osis' part) in warnings about stopping treatment. It also fires on the endings of suicidal-behavior words such as 'behaviors', 'actions' and 'suicidality'.

modes.label: Lactic acidosis
modes.description: The 'osis' ending of 'lactic acidosis' in advice to suspend treatment when findings suggest it.
modes.example: Suspend treatment if clinical or laboratory findings suggestive of lactic acid<<osis>> or pronounced hepatotoxicity occur.

modes.label: Suicidal thoughts and behavior
modes.description: The last part of words for suicidal behavior in antidepressant and sedative warnings.
modes.example: Suicidal Thoughts and Beh<<aviors>> in Children, Adolescents, and Young
